o1: Predicted to enable signaling receptor activity. Is involved in innate immune response and defense response to Gram-positive bacterium. Predicted to be involved in defense response to bacterium. Is expressed in intestine; nervous system; and pharynx. Used to study bacterial infectious disease. Orthologous to several human genes including LY75-CD302 (LY75-CD302 readthrough); LY75 (lymphocyte antigen 75); and MRC2 (mannose receptor C type 2).
